title: Concrete finite-hypercover cohomology with Grothendieck coefficients
statement: Let X be a qcqs scheme, A a Grothendieck abelian category with hom-universe one level above X, F an A-valued small-etale sheaf, and q a natural number. Finite split etale hypercovers form a category whose opposite, after quotienting refinements by simplicial homotopy, is filtered. Alternating section cohomology descends to this quotient. Define H_hyp^q(F) as its actual colimit. For every functor H from A-valued sheaves to A satisfying IsCohomologyColimit A q H (homotopy invariance and the refinement-compatible cocone universal property), there exists an isomorphism H_hyp^q(F) ≅ H(F). The definitions of finite split hypercover and Grothendieck coefficients are [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover] and [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian].

proof.text: A simplicial homotopy gives a chain homotopy after applying the presheaf contravariantly: use the opposite alternating-face complex and the degreewise identity identification with the alternating-coface complex. Homotopy-equivalent refinements therefore induce equal cohomology maps.

Construct the raw induced category of actual hypercovers and refinements, then its opposite homotopy quotient. Apply common refinements and equalization up to simplicial homotopy to prove that the quotient is filtered.

Descend the cohomology functor with Quotient.lift. Take its colimit using the Grothendieck colimits instance. Given IsCohomologyColimit, construct its cocone on the quotient and prove it is colimiting directly from the stated unique mediator. Uniqueness of colimits gives the isomorphism.
